title: Autonomous Routine
instructions:
Write an abstract class called `AutoRoutine` with:
- A regular method `run()` that calls `drivePhase()` then `actionPhase()` in order
- An abstract method `drivePhase()` (no parameters, returns nothing)
- An abstract method `actionPhase()` (no parameters, returns nothing)

Then write a class called `ScoreAuto` that extends `AutoRoutine`:
- `drivePhase()` prints "Driving to scoring zone"
- `actionPhase()` prints "Scoring game piece"

The `AutoRoutine` class is the template. `ScoreAuto` fills in the steps.
hint: Define `abstract fun drivePhase()` and `abstract fun actionPhase()` in AutoRoutine. The `run()` method calls both in order. ScoreAuto overrides each with a println.
